project.name: skills-ui
project.description: TUI/WebUI wrapper for the skills CLI — OpenTUI terminal app and local/hosted web UI over an authenticated loopback HTTP API, shipped as a self-contained Bun executable.

nodes.name: api.ts
nodes.summary: Loopback HTTP API server built on Bun.serve that exposes skill listing, search, installation, removal, update, preferences, and health-check routes. Enforces host/origin allowlists, bearer authentication, cross-site fetch rejection, token-bucket rate limiting, request body limits, and per-server list/description caching.

nodes.name: readJsonBody
nodes.summary: Reads and parses a JSON object request body up to the 1 MiB limit, returning an empty object for empty bodies. Throws BodyTooLarge for oversized payloads and BadJson for malformed or non-object JSON.

nodes.name: validSource
nodes.summary: Validates a skill source string up to 512 characters against control characters and leading-dash flag injection. Rejects HTTP(S) URLs that embed credentials or fail URL parsing.

nodes.name: createLimiter
nodes.summary: Creates a token-bucket rate limiter closure with configurable capacity and per-second refill rate. Consumes one token per allowed request and returns false when exhausted.

nodes.name: createSkillsUiServer
nodes.summary: Starts a 127.0.0.1 Bun HTTP server wiring all /api/* endpoints, optional HTML page rendering with hash-pinned CSP, per-server coalescing list/description caches, and hosted-UI CORS/bearer security gates. Falls back to an ephemeral port if the preferred port is unavailable and returns port metadata plus a stop handle.

nodes.name: hosted-auth.ts
nodes.summary: Authentication and browser-boundary protection helpers for hosted WebUI access to the local API server. Provides stable bearer token persistence, constant-time bearer verification, DNS-rebinding Host checks, cross-site fetch detection, and CORS/preflight responses.

nodes.name: hostedTokenPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the filesystem path for the persisted hosted-UI bearer token file, honoring SKILLS_UI_PREFS_DIR or defaulting to ~/.config/skills-ui/hosted-token.

nodes.name: getOrCreateHostedToken
nodes.summary: Returns the hosted-UI bearer token from SKILLS_UI_HOSTED_TOKEN, reads an existing persisted token file, or generates a 32-byte base64url token and writes it with mode 0600.

nodes.name: bearerMatches
nodes.summary: Verifies an Authorization header against the expected Bearer token using SHA-256 digests and crypto.timingSafeEqual to prevent timing leaks.

nodes.name: isCrossSiteFetch
nodes.summary: Detects hostile browser no-cors requests that omit the Origin header while carrying Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site.

nodes.name: isAllowedHost
nodes.summary: Validates the HTTP Host header against loopback hostnames (127.0.0.1, localhost, [::1], ::1) across any port to mitigate DNS-rebinding attacks.

nodes.name: isAllowedOrigin
nodes.summary: Checks whether an Origin header matches the built-in GitHub Pages origin, a local HTTP loopback origin, or an entry in SKILLS_UI_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

nodes.name: isSameOrigin
nodes.summary: Determines whether an HTTP request Origin header matches http://<host> from the request's own Host header.

nodes.name: corsHeaders
nodes.summary: Builds Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Vary: Origin response headers echoing an already-approved cross-origin caller.

nodes.name: preflightResponse
nodes.summary: Constructs a 204 No Content CORS preflight response permitting GET, POST, PUT, and OPTIONS with Authorization and Content-Type headers cached for 7200 seconds.

nodes.name: hooks.ts
nodes.summary: Manages user-configured external post-mutation hooks and health-check commands specified via SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK and SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD. Spawns executables in sanitized environments with timeouts, sanitizes output, and caches health-check results with in-flight deduplication.

nodes.name: isPostMutationHookConfigured
nodes.summary: Reports whether the SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK environment variable is set to a non-empty command path.

nodes.name: isHealthCmdConfigured
nodes.summary: Reports whether the SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD environment variable is set to a non-empty command path.

nodes.name: spawnExecutable
nodes.summary: Spawns an external executable via Bun.spawn with a sanitized environment, optional extra environment variables, stdout/stderr capture, and a kill timer. Returns structured exit code, output, timeout status, and spawn errors without throwing.

nodes.name: runPostMutationHook
nodes.summary: Runs the configured post-mutation hook executable with SKILLS_UI_EVENT, SKILLS_UI_SCOPE, SKILLS_UI_SKILLS, and SKILLS_UI_CWD environment variables. Returns a normalized PostMutationHookResult with sanitized output, exit code, and timeout or launch error reporting.

nodes.name: createHealthChecker
nodes.summary: Creates a stateful HealthChecker with configurable TTL caching, in-flight request deduplication, and explicit cache invalidation. Executes SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD, validates its JSON output shape, sanitizes summary/details fields, and gracefully handles spawn errors, timeouts, or invalid JSON.

nodes.name: checkHealth
nodes.summary: Runs a health check through the module-level default HealthChecker instance, optionally forcing a cache refresh.

nodes.name: invalidateHealthCache
nodes.summary: Clears the cached health-check result on the module-level default HealthChecker instance.

nodes.name: install.ts
nodes.summary: Service wrapper around `skills add --yes --json` for installing one, several, or all (`*`) skills from a source into project or global scope. Parses CLI JSON output and sanitizes all returned metadata fields at ingress.

nodes.name: install
nodes.summary: Invokes `skills add` with `--all` or repeated `--skill` flags and `--yes --json`, parses the resulting JSON entry array, and sanitizes every string field. Reports `ok: true` only when exit code is 0 and every entry has status `installed`.

nodes.name: installed.ts
nodes.summary: Lists and looks up installed skills for project or global scope via `skills ls --json`. Enriches each skill with provenance classification (`linked`, `locked`, or `local`) using symlink inspection and lockfile membership while sanitizing display metadata.

nodes.name: classifyProvenance
nodes.summary: Classifies an installed skill's provenance by checking whether its filesystem path is a symlink (`linked`), appears in the scope's lockfile (`locked`), or otherwise defaults to `local`.

nodes.name: listInstalled
nodes.summary: Executes `skills ls --json [-g]`, parses the returned array, cross-references lockfile entries for provenance, and sanitizes display fields while preserving raw filesystem paths.

nodes.name: findInstalled
nodes.summary: Finds a single installed skill by exact name within the requested project or global scope by delegating to `listInstalled`.

nodes.name: locks.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only lockfile reader for project (`skills-lock.json`) and global XDG state (`.skill-lock.json` / `skills-lock.json`) lock files. Validates entries individually with per-entry diagnostics while raising InvalidLockFileError on container-level corruption.

nodes.name: InvalidLockFileError
nodes.summary: Typed Error subclass thrown when an existing skills lock file has malformed JSON or an invalid root/skills container shape.

nodes.name: normalizeLock
nodes.summary: Validates a parsed lockfile container and partitions its `skills` map into valid LockEntry records and per-entry diagnostic messages while preserving unknown forward-compatible fields.

nodes.name: projectLockPath
nodes.summary: Computes the project-scope `skills-lock.json` path relative to the provided working directory or `process.cwd()`.

nodes.name: globalLockPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the global-scope skills lockfile path under XDG_STATE_HOME or ~/.local/state/skills, preferring `.skill-lock.json` and falling back to legacy `skills-lock.json`.

nodes.name: readLock
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes the project or global skills lockfile, returning an empty skills map if absent and throwing InvalidLockFileError on malformed JSON or invalid container structure.

nodes.name: remove.ts
nodes.summary: Service wrapper around `skills rm -y [-g]` that verifies removal accuracy by diffing before- and after-installed skill lists. Supports injectable `listBefore`/`listAfter` callbacks so the HTTP API can reuse and refresh its per-server cache.

nodes.name: remove
nodes.summary: Removes named skills via `skills rm` and compares pre- and post-removal installed listings to classify each skill as removed or still-present (`missing`), supporting optional cached listing hooks.

nodes.name: sanitize.ts
nodes.summary: CWE-150 terminal-escape and control-character scrubbing utilities applied at ingress for all external strings from the skills CLI, lockfiles, SKILL.md documents, and registry API.

nodes.name: stripEscapes
nodes.summary: Strips ANSI OSC, DCS/PM/APC, CSI, 8-bit C1 CSI, and two-byte terminal escape sequences from a string.

nodes.name: sanitizeMetadata
nodes.summary: Sanitizes single-line metadata strings by stripping terminal escape sequences and control characters, collapsing line breaks to spaces, and trimming whitespace.

nodes.name: sanitizeBody
nodes.summary: Sanitizes multi-line markdown bodies by stripping terminal escape sequences and disallowed control characters while preserving tabs and newlines.

nodes.name: search.ts
nodes.summary: Registry search client for skills.sh with in-flight request deduplication, ingress sanitization, and fuzzy fallback strategies including hyphenated-prefix gating, trailing-dash character fan-out, and progressive query shortening.

nodes.name: searchRegistryFuzzyOnce
nodes.summary: Executes a single timed GET request to the skills.sh `/api/search` endpoint, sanitizes returned skill metadata, sorts results by install count descending, and reports network or HTTP failures via `failed: true`.

nodes.name: searchRegistryFuzzy
nodes.summary: Deduplicates identical concurrent registry search requests keyed by `(query, owner)` in an in-flight promise map that clears immediately on settlement.

nodes.name: mapConcurrent
nodes.summary: Maps an async worker function over an input array with a bounded concurrency pool (default 6 workers) while preserving result order.

nodes.name: makeSearchWithFallback
nodes.summary: Builds a resilient search function over an injected registry fetcher with hyphenated-prefix gating, failure short-circuiting, trailing-separator alphanumeric fan-out, and progressive suffix shortening.

nodes.name: searchWithFallback
nodes.summary: Default registry search function instantiated by applying `makeSearchWithFallback` to `searchRegistryFuzzy` for use by both the HTTP API and TUI.

nodes.name: skill-doc.ts
nodes.summary: Reads skill documentation (`SKILL.md`) from either a direct file path or skill directory, strips leading YAML frontmatter, and sanitizes the markdown body for safe rendering.

nodes.name: readSkillDoc
nodes.summary: Reads UTF-8 text from a skill path or its nested `SKILL.md` file, returning null if neither candidate is a readable regular file.

nodes.name: stripFrontmatter
nodes.summary: Removes a leading `---`-delimited YAML frontmatter block and following blank lines from a markdown document string.

nodes.name: skillBody
nodes.summary: Loads a skill's `SKILL.md`, strips its YAML frontmatter, and runs `sanitizeBody` so escape sequences are removed while markdown layout is preserved.

nodes.name: source.ts
nodes.summary: Discovers skills available in an external source by running `skills install <source> --list --yes` with `FORCE_COLOR=1` and parsing sanitized skill names from cyan ANSI spans.

nodes.name: listSourceSkills
nodes.summary: Runs `skills install <source> --list --yes` with forced ANSI color, extracts deduplicated non-space skill names from cyan SGR-36 sequences, and sanitizes them at ingress.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared domain type and interface definitions for scopes, skill provenance, mutation events, hook/health-check payloads, installed/search skills, add results, and update-check reports.

nodes.name: update.ts
nodes.summary: Thin service wrapper around `skills update -p|-g -y [names]` that updates selected or all skills in a scope and sanitizes combined CLI output.

nodes.name: update
nodes.summary: Executes `skills update` with explicit project (`-p`) or global (`-g`) scope and optional skill names, returning exit status and sanitized combined output.

nodes.name: updates-check.ts
nodes.summary: Read-only update checker that compares locked GitHub skill folder SHAs against live repository trees fetched from the GitHub Trees API. Enforces strict tree completeness checks, null-prototype result maps, per-entry lock diagnostics, and inconclusive-status reporting for truncated or missing folders.

nodes.name: fetchRepoTree
nodes.summary: Fetches a recursive GitHub git tree for a segment-encoded repository path and explicit ref (defaulting to HEAD) with optional GITHUB_TOKEN auth and 10s timeout. Returns entries only when `truncated === false` and all nodes pass structural validation, otherwise null.

nodes.name: checkForUpdates
nodes.summary: Reads the scope's lockfile, surfaces per-entry lock diagnostics, batches GitHub skills by `(source, ref)` for concurrent tree fetches, and compares each folder SHA into a null-prototype updates map with explicit inconclusive/not-checkable statuses.

nodes.name: skills-client.ts
nodes.summary: Subprocess client for the external `skills` CLI executable with runtime binary resolution, allowlist/denylist environment sanitization, serialized spawn-queue execution, timeout enforcement, and version probing.

nodes.name: SkillsCliError
nodes.summary: Typed Error subclass raised when the `skills` binary cannot be spawned or returns unexpected `--version` output.

nodes.name: sanitizeEnv
nodes.summary: Filters process environment variables through an explicit allowlist, prefix allowlist, and hook/health denylist to strip agent-detection variables and prevent recursive hook invocation.

nodes.name: resolveSkillsBin
nodes.summary: Resolves and caches the `skills` CLI executable path from SKILLS_UI_SKILLS_BIN or defaults to `skills` on PATH.

nodes.name: resetSkillsBinCache
nodes.summary: Clears the cached `skills` binary path so subsequent invocations re-read SKILLS_UI_SKILLS_BIN.

nodes.name: runSkills
nodes.summary: Queues a `skills` CLI invocation through the module-level serialized spawn queue, rejecting with SkillsBusyError if the waiting cap is reached.

nodes.name: runSkillsUnqueued
nodes.summary: Spawns the resolved `skills` executable via Bun.spawn with sanitized environment, NO_COLOR/FORCE_COLOR handling, kill timeout, and combined stdout/stderr capture.

nodes.name: skillsVersion
nodes.summary: Runs `skills --version` with a 10-second timeout and validates that stdout starts with a semantic version string.

nodes.name: spawn-queue.ts
nodes.summary: Bounded FIFO async semaphore that serializes `skills` CLI child processes and rejects overflow requests immediately with SkillsBusyError to defend against request storms.

nodes.name: SkillsBusyError
nodes.summary: Error subclass thrown when the spawn queue waiting line reaches capacity and cannot accept additional concurrent CLI requests.

nodes.name: queueCap
nodes.summary: Reads and validates SKILLS_UI_SPAWN_QUEUE_CAP as a non-negative integer, defaulting to 8 waiting slots.

nodes.name: createSpawnQueue
nodes.summary: Creates a FIFO semaphore with configurable concurrency limit and dynamic queue-cap rejection, exposing `run` along with live `running` and `queued` counters.

nodes.name: hosted-auth.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit and HTTP integration test suite verifying hosted-UI bearer token generation/persistence, Host and Origin allowlists, CORS preflight behavior, token-free `/api/version` probing, and cross-origin bearer enforcement.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Test helper that boots an embedded-page `createSkillsUiServer` instance against the skills shim and captures the generated hosted-UI bearer token.

nodes.name: locks.test.ts
nodes.summary: Test suite covering per-entry lockfile validation and diagnostics, container-level InvalidLockFileError 400 mapping on `/api/updates`, `__proto__` prototype safety, and strict GitHub tree completeness/inconclusive-result handling.

nodes.name: sanitize.test.ts
nodes.summary: Unit and end-to-end ingress sanitization tests confirming ANSI/C1 escape and control-character stripping across `stripEscapes`, `sanitizeMetadata`, `sanitizeBody`, CLI service wrappers (`ls`, `install --list`, `add`), and HTTP API responses.

nodes.name: serve-hardening.test.ts
nodes.summary: Hostile-input security and resilience test suite verifying timing-safe bearer matching, FIFO spawn-queue overflow (503), GitHub tree URL encoding/completeness, cross-site fetch-metadata rejection, argv/shape boundary validation, 1 MiB body caps, rate limiting, and slow-handler idle timeouts.

nodes.name: start
nodes.summary: Test helper that starts a `createSkillsUiServer` instance with optional custom rate-limit configuration and returns its loopback base URL.

nodes.name: disk-index.ts
nodes.summary: Persists per-scope stale-while-revalidate caches of enriched installed skills to ~/.cache/skills-ui using atomic tmp-plus-rename writes and strict input sanitization. Partitions project-scope caches by SHA-256 hash and canonical projectRoot realpath while keeping global caches shared across projects.

nodes.name: sweepStaleTmp
nodes.summary: Best-effort cleanup that removes stale .tmp writer files matching an index prefix once they age past TMP_SWEEP_MIN_AGE_MS.

nodes.name: sweepStaleProjectIndexes
nodes.summary: Bounds cache directory growth by deleting aged per-project index JSON files other than the currently active project index.

nodes.name: diskIndexDir
nodes.summary: Resolves the disk index cache directory, prioritizing SKILLS_UI_CACHE_DIR, then an explicit override, and defaulting to ~/.cache/skills-ui.

nodes.name: projectIdentity
nodes.summary: Returns the canonical realpath of process.cwd() so symlink aliases of a project share one cache identity.

nodes.name: diskIndexPath
nodes.summary: Computes the persisted index filename for a scope, appending a SHA-256 hash of projectIdentity() for project scope and keeping global scope unsuffixed.

nodes.name: normalizeEntry
nodes.summary: Validates and sanitizes a single untrusted persisted skill record against the expected scope, dropping malformed or hostile entries without throwing.

nodes.name: normalizeDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Parses untrusted cache JSON into a version-2 PersistedIndex, enforcing size limits, scope-specific projectRoot ownership, and per-entry validation.

nodes.name: loadDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Safely reads and validates a scope's persisted skill index, returning null on missing, oversized, corrupt, or foreign-project files without throwing.

nodes.name: saveDiskIndex
nodes.summary: Atomically writes a subprocess-verified skill list to disk via a per-PID temporary file and POSIX rename after sweeping stale temp and project index litter.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Core barrel module that re-exports skill filtering, CLI subprocess helpers, installed/search/mutation/update/lock services, post-mutation hooks, and health checkers for TUI and web consumers.

nodes.name: prefs.ts
nodes.summary: Manages persistent UI preferences (theme, sound, reduceMotion, port, listWidth) stored in ~/.config/skills-ui/prefs.json with schema normalization and one-time migration from the upstream skills CLI.

nodes.name: uiPrefsPath
nodes.summary: Resolves the prefs.json path using SKILLS_UI_PREFS_DIR, an explicit directory override, or ~/.config/skills-ui/prefs.json.

nodes.name: normalizePreferences
nodes.summary: Merges recognized preference fields onto DEFAULT_UI_PREFERENCES, validating theme, sound, motion, port bounds, and migrating legacy pixel listWidth values into 10-50% bounds.

nodes.name: loadUiPreferences
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes prefs.json from disk, falling back cleanly to DEFAULT_UI_PREFERENCES when absent or corrupt.

nodes.name: saveUiPreferences
nodes.summary: Ensures the preferences parent directory exists and serializes formatted UiPreferences JSON to disk.

nodes.name: importSkillsPrefsOnce
nodes.summary: Performs a one-time best-effort copy of ~/.config/skills/ui-prefs.json into the skills-ui prefs path when the destination does not yet exist.

nodes.name: seed.ts
nodes.summary: Parses CLI command arguments (add, update, remove and aliases) into a structured UiSeed describing which tab, query, or skill selections the UI should pre-populate on launch.

nodes.name: positionals
nodes.summary: Walks an argument array and extracts bare positional tokens while skipping known value-taking flags and their arguments.

nodes.name: flagValues
nodes.summary: Collects all non-flag token values immediately following occurrences of a specified value-taking flag such as --skill or -s.

nodes.name: parseUiSeed
nodes.summary: Interprets stripped CLI command arguments into a typed UiSeed discriminated union (none, add, update, or remove) for initial TUI/web state.

nodes.name: theme.ts
nodes.summary: Defines Catppuccin Mocha and Latte color palettes, WCAG 2.x contrast calculations, AA-compliant semantic theme tokens, ANSI terminal color painters, and OpenTUI TextMate syntax highlighting themes.

nodes.name: hexToRgb
nodes.summary: Validates a 6-digit hex color string and converts it into an [r, g, b] byte tuple, throwing on invalid input.

nodes.name: relativeLuminance
nodes.summary: Computes WCAG 2.x relative luminance for a hex color using linearized sRGB channel weights.

nodes.name: contrastRatio
nodes.summary: Calculates the WCAG contrast ratio (1..21) between foreground and background hex colors.

nodes.name: darkenToContrast
nodes.summary: Iteratively darkens a hex color toward black until it satisfies a minimum WCAG contrast ratio against a target background.

nodes.name: buildThemeTokens
nodes.summary: Derives the full WCAG AA-compliant ThemeTokens record for a Catppuccin palette, darkening light-theme status and text accents as needed.

nodes.name: tokensFor
nodes.summary: Returns the precomputed semantic ThemeTokens for a given ThemeName (mocha or latte).

nodes.name: createAnsiPainter
nodes.summary: Creates an AnsiPainter encoding foreground, background, bold, and reset ANSI escape sequences in truecolor or 256-color fallback mode.

nodes.name: syntaxTokensFor
nodes.summary: Maps markdown and common source-code TextMate scopes to Catppuccin palette styles for OpenTUI's SyntaxStyle.fromTheme.

nodes.name: Views.tsx
nodes.summary: OpenTUI React view layer that subscribes to the Elm-style TuiModel store via useSyncExternalStore and renders the splash screen, header, installed/search/settings tabs, 3D graph host, footer, and animated overlays.

nodes.name: useApp
nodes.summary: React hook returning the AppBridge context connecting view components to the TUI store, dispatch, audio, and detail loaders.

nodes.name: mountApp
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenTUI React root on a CliRenderer, mounts App inside AppProvider, and returns an unmount callback.

nodes.name: usePopInOverlay
nodes.summary: Custom hook that animates absolute-positioned modal overlays sliding into place over 180ms via OpenTUI timelines when reduceMotion is explicitly disabled.

nodes.name: App
nodes.summary: Root React component subscribing to TuiModel changes and switching between the startup splash, main tab/graph layout, footer, and active modal overlays.

nodes.name: Splash
nodes.summary: Renders the full-screen startup splash view with a procedural Catppuccin gradient banner and live loading status text.

nodes.name: GraphView
nodes.summary: Dynamically loads three-scene.ts to host a per-renderer 3D skill graph ThreeRenderable with optional timeline rotation, degrading cleanly when WebGPU is unavailable.

nodes.name: Header
nodes.summary: Renders the top navigation bar displaying tab indicators, search install-queue badge, optional hub health status pill, active scope, and busy spinner text.

nodes.name: checkedTitle
nodes.summary: Formats the checked-count border title so it stays within the 19-character 80-column pane budget by dropping the total when needed.

nodes.name: installedListTitle
nodes.summary: Computes the live border title for the installed-skills pane reflecting active agent filters, text filter cursor, checked count, sort mode, and provenance filter.

nodes.name: searchListTitle
nodes.summary: Computes a width-bounded border title for the search pane showing the active query, editing cursor, result count, and fuzzy-adjusted query hint.

nodes.name: useSelectionScrollFollow
nodes.summary: Synchronizes a ScrollBoxRenderable's scrollTop with the currently selected row's screen coordinates or fallback index so the active item remains in view.

nodes.name: skillRowStyle
nodes.summary: Resolves foreground, background, provenance badge, and bold styling attributes for an installed skill row based on selection and checked state.

nodes.name: InstalledSkillRow
nodes.summary: Renders a single installed skill row with check/cursor prefixes, name, provenance badge, source label, update arrow, and mouse click selection.

nodes.name: InstalledDetailPane
nodes.summary: Renders the right-hand markdown documentation scrollbox, agent/scope/provenance metadata line, and update-check error diagnostics for the focused installed skill.

nodes.name: InstalledBody
nodes.summary: Composes the resizable split installed-skills list and markdown detail pane with memoized Catppuccin syntax highlighting and scroll-follow synchronization.

nodes.name: highlightSegments
nodes.summary: Splits a string into matched and unmatched text runs for case-insensitive occurrences of the first matching search needle (raw or fuzzy-adjusted query).

nodes.name: HighlightedRuns
nodes.summary: Renders segmented text runs from highlightSegments with bold accent styling on matched substrings.

nodes.name: SearchResultRow
nodes.summary: Renders a registry search result row with queue/selection markers, procedural source identicon badge, highlighted name/source runs, and install count.

nodes.name: SearchQueueSection
nodes.summary: Renders the staged install-queue section beneath search results with pane-focus highlighting and per-item cursor selection.

nodes.name: SearchRepoSkillsList
nodes.summary: Displays sibling skills discovered within the currently selected search result's source repository.

nodes.name: SearchDetailPane
nodes.summary: Renders the right-hand search inspection pane showing source metadata, install status in the active scope, queue status, failure messaging, and sibling repository skills.

nodes.name: SearchBody
nodes.summary: Composes the split search-results/queue list pane, detail inspector pane, and command hint strip capped at SEARCH_RENDER_CAP rows.

nodes.name: SettingsBody
nodes.summary: Renders the Settings tab displaying app and skills CLI versions along with interactive theme, sound, motion, and list-width preference controls.

nodes.name: Footer
nodes.summary: Renders the constant-width keybinding legend and transient toast or confirmation status text along the bottom edge of the TUI.

nodes.name: HelpOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the centered modal keybinding reference sheet with optional pop-in motion when help mode is open.

nodes.name: AgentSelectOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the multi-select agent filter modal displaying staged checkboxes, cursor state, and apply/cancel shortcuts.

nodes.name: HealthOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the hub health diagnostics modal showing OK/FAIL summary and detailed check lines when a health command is configured.

nodes.name: ConfirmOverlay
nodes.summary: Renders the destructive remove/update confirmation modal, highlighting warnings when selected skills have non-locked (linked or local) provenance.

nodes.name: app.ts
nodes.summary: Imperative TUI runtime orchestrating signal crash guards, real core service dependencies with scope list caching, Elm-store dispatch, SWR disk-index loading, debounced search, post-mutation hooks, and the full keyboard contract.

nodes.name: installCrashGuard
nodes.summary: Registers idempotent SIGINT, SIGTERM, SIGHUP, uncaughtException, and exit handlers so terminal state and audio resources are always restored before process exit.

nodes.name: runTui
nodes.summary: Production TUI entrypoint that verifies TTY output, constructs a CliRenderer, installs the crash guard, runs runTuiOn, and disposes audio on exit.

nodes.name: runTuiOn
nodes.summary: Mounts the TUI React view tree on any real or in-memory CliRenderer, wiring store subscriptions, FIFO toasts, SWR skill loading, stale-guarded search/update checks, mutation hooks, resize handling, and modal/text/command keymaps.

nodes.name: art.ts
nodes.summary: Generates procedural RGBA pixel art (startup splash gradient banner and deterministic 4x2 source identicon badges) using OpenTUI NativeImage and Catppuccin palettes so the binary ships zero image assets.

nodes.name: splashImage
nodes.summary: Synthesizes and caches a 96x28 RGBA diagonal Catppuccin accent gradient NativeImage with soft horizontal edge fade for the startup splash screen.

nodes.name: sourceBadge
nodes.summary: Generates and caches a deterministic 2-color 4x2 RGBA identicon NativeImage hashed from a search result's source string and active theme.

nodes.name: audio.ts
nodes.summary: Synthesizes preference-gated UI feedback sounds (select, confirm, success, error) as 44.1 kHz f32le PCM sine envelopes streamed through OpenTUI's Audio engine with silent failure degradation.

nodes.name: ensure
nodes.summary: Lazily imports and initializes OpenTUI's Audio engine singleton, caching failure state so missing audio hardware degrades silently without blocking the TUI.

nodes.name: toneBytes
nodes.summary: Async generator yielding 44.1 kHz mono f32le PCM byte chunks for a decaying sine-wave tone envelope.

nodes.name: playSound
nodes.summary: Streams the note sequence for a SoundKind through OpenTUI Audio when sound preferences are enabled, catching and silencing playback errors.

nodes.name: disposeAudio
nodes.summary: Best-effort teardown that disposes the active OpenTUI Audio instance and clears the singleton reference during app shutdown.

nodes.name: model.ts
nodes.summary: Pure renderer-agnostic Elm-style state store for the TUI defining TuiModel, Action union, filtering/sorting projections, scope-isolated update-check records, and immutable state transitions.

nodes.name: createTuiModel
nodes.summary: Constructs the initial TuiModel state populated with user preferences, empty per-scope update maps, splash flag, and default filter/sort settings.

nodes.name: applySeed
nodes.summary: Applies a CLI UiSeed to a freshly created TuiModel, pre-selecting the search tab/query for add or pre-checking target skills for update/remove.

nodes.name: visibleSkills
nodes.summary: Computes the filtered and sorted view of installed skills intersecting text match (via skillMatches), agent multi-select, provenance filter, and checked/name/load sort order.

nodes.name: visibleSearchResults
nodes.summary: Returns search results ordered by load relevance, queued-first, or alphabetical name according to model.searchSortBy.

nodes.name: applySkillsLoaded
nodes.summary: Reconciles newly loaded skills (including SWR stale-to-fresh swaps) by preserving cursor focus on the same skill name and pruning vanished checked skills.

nodes.name: applyMove
nodes.summary: Advances and clamps the active list cursor across installed skills, search results (capped at SEARCH_RENDER_CAP), or the search install queue.

nodes.name: applyHomeEnd
nodes.summary: Jumps the active cursor to the first or last rendered row in the installed list, search results, or search queue pane.

nodes.name: applyCheckAction
nodes.summary: Handles single-row check toggling, check-all, toggle-all, invert-checks, and clear-checks over the currently visible installed skills.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand what skills-ui is: a self-contained Bun executable that wraps the stock skills CLI across an OpenTUI terminal app, a local web dashboard, a headless loopback HTTP API, and a hosted GitHub Pages frontend. Pair it with CONTEXT.md, the domain glossary that pins shared terminology across both interfaces, including layout panels, Skill Provenance (locked, linked, local), Post-Mutation Hooks, and the Health Pill. Together, these two documents frame the architectural boundaries and vocabulary you will see throughout the codebase.

tour.title: CLI Entry Point
tour.description: Moving from documentation into executable code, src/main.ts is the sole CLI entry point that parses --port and routes execution to --version, --selftest, headless serve, interactive --web, or the default OpenTUI application. When invoked with subcommands like add, update, or remove, src/core/seed.ts parses those arguments into a structured UiSeed so whichever UI launches can pre-populate the matching tab and selections. Meanwhile, src/core/version.ts supplies the single APP_VERSION constant by reading the compile-time __APP_VERSION__ define in release binaries and falling back to package.json during local development.

tour.title: Shared Core Runtime Primitives
tour.description: Before examining specific UIs or services, look at the shared runtime primitives that keep the TUI and WebUI visually and behaviorally consistent. prefs.ts persists theme, sound, reduced-motion, port, and list-width settings in ~/.config/skills-ui/prefs.json, while theme.ts defines Catppuccin Mocha and Latte palettes with WCAG AA contrast tokens for both terminal ANSI output and CSS. filter.ts defines the single skillMatches predicate shared verbatim across TUI and browser filtering, and disk-index.ts stores atomic stale-while-revalidate caches under ~/.cache/skills-ui so the TUI can paint hundreds of skills instantly on launch.
tour.languageLesson: Writing pure, template-literal-safe TypeScript in src/core/filter.ts allows the web renderer to inline the transpiled function directly into the browser script, guaranteeing identical filtering semantics across Bun and browser runtimes without a separate client bundler.

tour.title: Subprocess Boundary & Sanitization
tour.description: Because skills-ui intentionally has no build-time dependency on the upstream skills package, every CLI invocation crosses a hardened subprocess boundary. skills-client.ts resolves the skills executable at runtime (SKILLS_UI_SKILLS_BIN then PATH), filters child environment variables through allowlists and denylists, and enforces command timeouts, while spawn-queue.ts serializes child processes through a bounded FIFO semaphore that fails fast with SkillsBusyError under request storms. Every external string coming back across that boundary is scrubbed by sanitize.ts against CWE-150 terminal escape injection, and src/core/index.ts exposes the clean barrel API consumed by upper layers.
tour.languageLesson: A bounded async FIFO semaphore (spawn-queue.ts) queues Promise resolvers in JavaScript's single-threaded event loop to cap concurrent child processes without busy-waiting, while barrel files (src/core/index.ts) use explicit re-exports to define a clear module facade.

tour.title: Core Skill Domain Services
tour.description: Building on the subprocess boundary from Step 4, the domain services implement skill discovery and lifecycle mutations against the shared interfaces in types.ts. installed.ts wraps skills ls --json and combines symlink inspection with locks.ts's read-only lockfile parser (skills-lock.json and global XDG .skill-lock.json) to classify each skill's provenance as locked, linked, or local while surfacing per-entry diagnostics. install.ts wraps skills add --yes --json with ingress sanitization, and remove.ts verifies deletions by diffing before-and-after skill lists via injectable callbacks so the HTTP API can reuse its warm cache.

tour.title: Search, Updates & Hooks
tour.description: Beyond wrapping the skills CLI, several domain services read local files or talk to external registries directly to keep hot paths fast and extensible. search.ts queries the public skills.sh registry with in-flight request deduplication and fuzzy fallback strategies, while updates-check.ts compares locked GitHub folder SHAs from Step 5's lock reader against the GitHub Trees API with strict completeness checks and null-prototype result maps. skill-doc.ts reads and strips YAML frontmatter from SKILL.md files on disk with zero subprocesses, and hooks.ts executes user-configured SKILLS_UI_POST_MUTATION_HOOK and TTL-cached SKILLS_UI_HEALTH_CMD commands in sanitized environments.

tour.title: Loopback HTTP API & Auth
tour.description: When launched with serve or --web from Step 2, src/core/api.ts starts a Bun.serve loopback server that exposes all domain services from Steps 5 and 6 over JSON endpoints. To shield users from slow upstream skills ls scans, the server maintains per-scope list caches, coalesces concurrent reads, enforces request body limits and token-bucket rate limits, and serves zero-spawn detail lookups by exact path. hosted-auth.ts guards the browser-to-loopback boundary for both local and hosted GitHub Pages clients with persisted constant-time bearer tokens, DNS-rebinding Host checks, cross-site Fetch Metadata rejection, and strict CORS preflight handling.
tour.languageLesson: Binding to 127.0.0.1 alone does not protect a local HTTP API from malicious browser tabs: validating Host/Origin headers blocks DNS rebinding, checking Sec-Fetch-Site rejects cross-site requests, and constant-time token comparison prevents timing leaks.

tour.title: OpenTUI State & Views
tour.description: When launched in default terminal mode, skills-ui runs an OpenTUI React application structured around an Elm-style separation of pure state, imperative runtime effects, and declarative rendering. model.ts defines the renderer-agnostic TuiModel, its Action union, immutable reducers, and scope-isolated filtering and sorting projections reusing Step 3's skillMatches predicate. app.ts orchestrates core services, instant SWR hydration from disk-index.ts, debounced search, crash guards, and the keyboard contract, while Views.tsx subscribes to the store via useSyncExternalStore to paint the split-pane tabs, overlays, and health strip.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript discriminated unions (Action in model.ts) let the compiler check state transitions exhaustively, while React's useSyncExternalStore safely bridges an external imperative store into declarative components without concurrent tearing.

tour.title: TUI Media, 3D & Selftest
tour.description: Complementing the core TUI views from Step 8, these modules add procedural media, 3D visualization, and deterministic headless verification without bundling static image or audio files into the executable. art.ts synthesizes Catppuccin RGBA splash gradients and deterministic source identicons in memory, audio.ts generates preference-gated 44.1 kHz PCM feedback tones, and three-scene.ts builds a 3D Fibonacci-sphere skills graph via @opentui/three. Finally, spike.ts defines the tree-sitter markdown selftest screen invoked by --selftest, and renderer-ready.ts polls in-memory frames deterministically so smoke checks never rely on brittle sleeps.

tour.title: Single-File Web Dashboard UI
tour.description: The web frontend mirrors the TUI's split-pane workflow in a single standalone HTML document served locally by Step 7's API or exported to GitHub Pages for zero-install hosted use. page.ts assembles the Catppuccin CSS from styles.ts together with three modular browser JavaScript fragments: core.ts for sessionStorage-backed bearer auth, WebAudio cues, and hosted connection probing; installed.ts for keyed DOM-reusing row reconciliation, shared filter parity, and escape-first SKILL.md markdown rendering; and search-and-boot.ts for registry search, batch install queues, and startup bootstrapping. For defense-in-depth, page.ts computes SHA-256 hashes of every emitted script block to serve a strict Content-Security-Policy without script unsafe-inline.

tour.title: Build, Release & Verified Install
tour.description: Turning the TypeScript codebase into a distributable binary starts in package.json, which declares Bun >=1.4 dependencies and developer scripts for testing, building, and exporting the hosted page. scripts/build.ts cross-compiles src/main.ts into four standalone darwin and linux executables with __APP_VERSION__ baked in, macOS JIT codesigning, and a SHA-256 checksums manifest, which scripts/verify-build-targets.ts audits for target architecture and digest accuracy. End users consume those artifacts through scripts/install.sh, a POSIX shell installer that verifies SHA-256 checksums against tag-committed manifests and swaps binaries atomically, following the full release checklist documented in docs/release.md.

tour.title: Testing, Performance Budgets & CI
tour.description: To verify every layer hermetically without mutating real user skills or hitting live registries, the test architecture centers on tests/fixtures/skills-shim.mjs, an executable CLI stand-in with persistent state files, failure injection, and JSONL spawn logging. Security and resilience invariants (timing-safe auth, spawn-queue 503 overflow, body caps, and cross-site fetch rejection) are pinned in tests/serve-hardening.test.ts, while scripts/perf/budget.ts benchmarks API caching, search deduplication, and Playwright DOM row identity against ratified budgets. Real-terminal behavior is verified end-to-end inside a Python pyte pseudoterminal by scripts/pty-smoke/smoke.py, and .github/workflows/claude-code-review.yml automates pull-request reviews in GitHub Actions.
tour.languageLesson: GitHub Actions workflows define event triggers (on: pull_request), least-privilege permissions, and sequential job steps in YAML to run automated PR review gates alongside hermetic local shims and real-PTY smoke harnesses.
